slides.title: Democracy’s Political Unthought
slides.text: Democracy’s Political Unthought Or: How I Learned to Love Democracy 2/7 “How I Learned” gives away that I did not love democracy in advance. Democracy as an object of worry Threatened, hollowed out, to be defended. Democracy as a legitimating formula Namig how its supposed “outsides” are to be governed. Stanley Kubrick, Dr. Strangelove or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb, 1964. Film poster: Tomi Ungerer. Staunæs 2026: 114–118.

slides.title: Democracy’s Political Unthought
slides.text: Democracy’s Political Unthought Or: How I Learned to Love Democracy 2/7 Democracy as constitutional order Rights and representative institutions, contested and extended through parties, associations, social movements and collective struggle. Democracy as technical arrangement Arrangements through which expression is received, sorted, amplified and judged. Democracy as the ritual exposure of artifice The technics allocating voice, authority and consequence can themselves be contested. Staunæs 2026: 81–86, 108–109, 114–118.

slides.title: Expressing the Ideological Substrate
slides.text: Expressing the Ideological Substrate Or: How I Learned to Build Ideology 4/7 “There is as yet no formal leadership of The Synthetic Party. It is a production we have made ourselves, and it is made from the opinions of others. The production does not follow any particular ideology. However, the ideas have undergone a process through which they have been made funny and functional in a political party.” Computer Lars / Det Syntetiske Parti, “Meddelelser fra ledelsen”, Medium, 24 March 2022. English translation from the original blog. Staunæs 2026: 24–25.

slides.title: Expressing the Ideological Substrate
slides.text: Expressing the Ideological Substrate Or: How I Learned to Build Ideology 4/7 Valgnævnet, register of party names, 21 December 2022, p. 2. Column headings and detail: Det Syntetiske Parti, approved 26 April 2022. Training material: More than 200 Danish micro-parties and extra-parliamentary formations. Claimed constituency: The “20% who do not normally vote”, as formulated in the 2022 launch statement. Relation: A negative symmetry, not sociological representation. Operational logic: 15–20% abstention corresponds to approximately 27–36 of 179 parliamentary seats, as a counterfactual seat-equivalent, not real mandates. Staunæs 2026: 9–10, 43–48, 127.

slides.title: Expressing the Ideological Substrate
slides.text: Expressing the Ideological Substrate Or: How I Learned to Build Ideology 4/7 Twenty-billion-parameter autoregressive language model. Training: Fine-tuning on the micro-party corpus. Inference: Programme generation through text completion; conversational address through Leader Lars. EleutherAI, GPT-NeoX-20B. Model weights released 9 February 2022. EleutherAI 2022; Staunæs 2026: 43–48.

slides.title: Democratic Specification
slides.text: Democratic Specification Or: How I Learned to Machine-Love 7/7 Democracy as a property of algorithms running on infrastructural substrates. A democratic frontier relative to a substrate, not a democracy-in-itself. Democracy can function and fork without preserving its inherited constitutional shell. Governance function Habitability floor Democratic frontier Contestability first; extension breaks ties. Article 7: Staunæs 2026: 305, 307–308.

slides.title: Democratic Specification
slides.text: Democratic Specification Or: How I Learned to Machine-Love 7/7 SYNTHESIS Democracy ceases to remain the unquestioned regime surrounding AI-driven political formations and is synthesised material in its own right. Emily M. Bender, Mastodon, 29 October 2022, post 6. Bender discussed: Staunæs 2026: 85. Synthesis: 107–109, 114–118.

slides.title: Democratic Specification
slides.text: Democratic Specification Or: How I Learned to Machine-Love 7/7 Represented and representative no longer stand as fixed endpoints. Their systematic re-generation is itself something a political practice can generate. “Unrepresented” includes the terms of conversion through which something becomes represented. Computer Lars, “Forfatning for Det Syntetiske Parti”, §50. Medium, 7 April 2022. Synthesis: Staunæs 2026: 107–109, 114–118.
